parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the gateway device.

> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the gateway device. This is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device. It corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**.

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** combination, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The key of the product to which the gateway belongs. The key is the unique identifier of the product.

> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
